question_text: A 38-year-old woman comes to the physician because of a 1-month history of fatigue and pruritus. Examination of the abdomen shows an enlarged, nontender liver. Serum antimitochondrial antibody titers are elevated. A biopsy specimen of this patient's liver is most likely to show which of the following findings?
